subject: Energy
title: Nuclear and AI Data Centers
description: A micro-lesson that makes Nuclear and AI Data Centers usable.

hook.text: AI data centers need 24/7 clean power—and tech giants are turning to nuclear energy to meet their climate pledges.

buildup.text: A single large AI data center can consume 100+ MW—equivalent to a small city's electricity demand running nonstop.

discovery.text: Microsoft signed a deal to restart Three Mile Island's Unit 1—purchasing all its power for its Azure data centers.

twist.text: Google and Amazon are also signing nuclear PPAs—nuclear's reliability matches data centers' need for constant uptime.

climax.text: The AI boom could revive nuclear—creating demand for reliable baseload power that renewables alone struggle to provide.

punchline.text: AI needs always-on power—nuclear fits perfectly.

quiz.question: Why are tech companies interested in nuclear power?
options: It provides reliable 24/7 clean power for data centers
